dna.initial: Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE original publication-quality biomedical mechanism icon: a short HORIZONTAL double-stranded DNA helix, on a genuinely transparent background. BioRender-like clarity and restraint, matching a flat biomedical SVG icon family. Show about 2.5 smooth helical turns with TWO continuous broad ribbon-like sugar-phosphate backbones, approximately 12 evenly spaced short paired rungs bridging the strands. Clear alternating over-under occlusion at every crossing, a calm even rhythm, spacious readable grooves. Overall width about 3.2 times height. Centered, generous empty margins. The lower strand should form a smooth downward-facing trough around the middle of the segment, leaving a clean accessible outer bottom contour for a transcription-factor binding anchor. Muted teal #69ADB5 and soft lavender #B2A6CD for the two strands, restrained pale mint #B3D7CC base-pair rungs. Very fine slate #3D5963 outline where useful. Rounded ends and consistent ribbon thickness; crisp smooth flat solid-color shapes optimized for conversion to editable SVG. No atomistic balls, beads, chemical formulas, letters, labels, arrows, caps, gradients, glow, texture, drop shadows or decorative highlights. It must read as a beautiful clean DNA duplex at 180 px wide, not two thin sinusoidal wires or an electrical spring. Do not imitate any exact proprietary artwork.
dna.correction: Keep this exact DNA icon, colors, proportions, transparent background, ribbon thickness and all base-pair rungs. Correct only the over-under layering: there are THREE crossover regions across the width. At the LEFT and RIGHT crossovers the teal backbone passes IN FRONT of lavender. At the CENTRAL crossover, the lavender backbone must instead pass IN FRONT of teal, with its two outline edges continuing uninterrupted diagonally from lower-left toward upper-right; the teal ribbon is visibly interrupted behind it. This alternating front/back order is essential for a proper double helix. No additional turns or labels. Keep the finished image flat and clean.
dna.acceptedRegeneration: Create an ORIGINAL scientific flat VECTOR-STYLE DNA double helix icon on transparent background. HORIZONTAL 3:1 aspect ratio, approximately TWO full turns, with two rounded broad ribbons and short thin base pair rungs between. Use teal #69ADB5 and lavender #B2A6CD, pale mint #B3D7CC rungs, fine #3D5963 outline, zero shading/gradient/glow. CRITICAL CORRECT GEOMETRY: at successive ribbon intersections from left to right, the visible FRONT ribbon must alternate TEAL, LAVENDER, TEAL, LAVENDER. At an intersection where lavender is in front, show a small visible clean break in the teal contour behind it. At the next intersection teal is continuous and lavender is broken behind. This alternating over-under layering is the main priority. Draw the two ends of the duplex as open paired ends. Keep base pair rungs evenly distributed, approximately 12, with no nucleotides floating loose. Calm, restrained, professional BioRender-like mechanism artwork, beautiful smooth outlines with 2-4 solid colors, lots of empty transparent margin. No labels, text, shadows, or decorative marks. It should look like a twisted ladder with unambiguous alternating occlusion, not tangled waves or one strand laid over the other everywhere. Favor geometric clarity over realism.

rna.accepted: Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE original publication-quality biomedical mechanism icon: a short HORIZONTAL single-stranded RNA transcript on a genuinely transparent background, in the same quiet BioRender-like flat scientific illustration language as a modern biomedical SVG icon family. One continuous smooth rounded medium-thickness backbone forming a relaxed asymmetric flowing curve with just two broad bends, NOT a helix, coil, spring or hairpin. About 12 small tidy rounded nucleotide tabs attached directly along ONE side of the backbone, following its curvature, evenly spaced and visually subordinate. The strand is a readable dark muted lavender #B2A6CD with a very fine slate #3D5963 outline; nucleotide tabs are muted teal #69ADB5 with a few pale mint #B3D7CC tabs. Overall width about 3.3 times height. Both ends clearly open and rounded; no 5-prime cap, poly-A tail or asserted sequence because this represents a generic newly transcribed RNA. Crisp intentional flat solid-color shapes, clean curved silhouette, generous transparent margins, no text, letters, numbering, arrows, beads, chemical formulas, gradient, shadow, glow, gloss or texture. Beautiful at 140 px wide; avoid flimsy disconnected strokes. Do not imitate any exact proprietary artwork.
